headline: Pavol's 1 Nov rule for quiz apps is live (#26). An okruh or daily set left partway waits on Home as "Rozpracovaná sada". Pokračovat resumes the same set at the first unanswered question; Nový trénink starts a fresh set that skips answered questions. A mock exam left early keeps its answers and records no score.

shipped.title: An unfinished set waits on Home: Pokračovat or Nový trénink
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01 ~18:55Z on the deployed site at 390 px. Tested flow: a Dopravní značky set, 8 answered, ← Konec, reload. Home showed the card "Rozpracovaná sada · Dopravní značky · Zodpovězeno 8 z 20" with Pokračovat → and Nový trénink, with no horizontal overflow. Pokračovat opened "09 / 20", "Dopravní značky · sada 1 z 12 · otázky 1–20 z 222", on the same question that was 9th before leaving. Mock-exam behaviour and the correction-round resume were checked in unit and journey tests, not on live.

decisions.question: Rule 1: does an answer already count when given, and does a new set skip answered questions?
decisions.why: Progress was already recorded on every tap, okruh sets put never-answered questions first, and the daily set's review share is capped at 40 %, which is a minority. Tests now cover it: a new set after leaving at 8 contains none of those 8.

decisions.question: Which sets wait when left unfinished?
options: okruh sets and the daily set
decisions.default_taken: okruh sets and the daily set
decisions.why: This is the scope in the brief. Moje chyby and Záložky rebuild from progress each time, and starting them (or an exam) leaves a waiting set alone. Only starting a new okruh or daily set replaces it.

decisions.question: Does a set left with zero answers wait?
decisions.why: Nothing to come back to; the card would be noise.

decisions.question: When does the set's conversion fire if it has a correction round?
options: at the end of the first round (as before)
decisions.default_taken: at the end of the first round (as before)
decisions.why: Every question has then been answered, which keeps the existing Kontrola chyby metric. A resumed correction round is flagged so the conversion is not sent twice. The streak still lands only on the results screen, with no partial threshold.

decisions.question: Opening a /okruh/ or /otazka/ link (or reloading one mid-set) while a set waits
options: show Home with the waiting set
start the landing page's practice and drop the waiting set
decisions.default_taken: show Home with the waiting set
decisions.why: Without this, a reload mid-set on an SEO landing page silently replaced the set. This was found by the independent review.

decisions.question: Analytics for the prompt
decisions.why: Pokračovat sends key_action {action:'round_resumed', mode, answered, total}. Nový trénink sends start_lesson or start_practice with from:'resume-prompt'. No new event names, as asked.

decisions.question: Whose is the snapshot after sign-out?
options: the device's (shown to whoever uses it)
decisions.why: The brief says per-device localStorage, not synced. Answers given after resuming go to whoever is signed in.

next: Carry the same rule to the other quiz apps (logika-kviz PR #14 is the reference; zbrojni-kviz shares this engine).
Připravenost (Bloom readiness) is still waiting for Pavol's pick: A / B / C; the recommendation is B.
Watch key_action round_resumed against the number of sets left unfinished, to see whether the card is used.
